summary_text: In June 2026, the user placed 11 independent orders, predominantly on weekdays and during the morning daypart. While Milk and Breads appear together in multiple orders, this behavior is not yet established as a stable, recurring pattern due to the lack of repetition across independent dates for specific category sets. Shopping needs vary from basic meal preparation to specific ceremonial requirements and personal care restocking.
